description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'MockLegacySecurityCluster' representing a security device cluster with capabilities such as handling device status, battery info, temperature, and communication commands within a Zigbee-like environment. It includes methods for sending commands, handling manufacturer-specific commands, and managing device attributes such as battery voltage, temperature, RSSI, and LQI.

classes.name: MockLegacySecurityCluster
classes.description: Abstract class representing a security device cluster with capabilities for handling battery status, temperature, signal quality, and communication commands within a Zigbee environment.

classes.name: ServerMfgCommand
classes.description: Inner static class defining manufacturer-specific command IDs (set device number and ping).

methods.name: sendPingCommand
methods.description: Sends a ping command to the device if so configured.

methods.name: sendStatusCommand
methods.description: Sends a status request command to the device, optionally waiting for an acknowledgment.

methods.name: sendGodparentInfo
methods.description: Sends godparent info message with specified device numbers, optionally waiting for acknowledgment.

methods.name: sendCheckinCommmand
methods.description: Sends a check-in command to the device.

methods.name: handleMfgCommand
methods.description: Handles manufacturer-specific commands such as setting device number or responding to pings.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status bytes of the device.

methods.name: setvBattNominal
methods.description: Sets the nominal battery voltage value.

methods.name: setvBattLow
methods.description: Sets the low battery voltage threshold.

methods.name: isLowBattery
methods.description: Checks if the device's battery is considered low.

methods.name: setBatteryVoltage
methods.description: Updates the device's battery voltage if the value is within valid range.

methods.name: setTemperature
methods.description: Updates the device's temperature reading in centi-degrees Celsius.

methods.name: getRssi
methods.description: Returns the received signal strength indicator (RSSI).
